response.title: Dune
response.overview: “Dune” tells the story of Paul Atreides, a gifted young man born into a great destiny, who must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his people.

response.title: Dune: Part Two
response.overview: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking vengeance for the death of his family.

response.title: Dune
response.overview: An all-star cast enlivens Frank Herbert’s classic epic novel, which traces the saga of an intergalactic warrior and his messianic rise to leadership.

response.title: Frank Herbert's Dune
response.overview: A three-part miniseries on politics, betrayal, lust, greed and the coming of a Messiah. Based on Frank Herbert's classic science fiction novel.

response.title: Dune: Prophecy
response.overview: From author Frank Herbert's expansive Dune universe, the prequel series Dune: Prophecy follows two Harkonnen sisters as they combat forces that threaten the future of humankind – and establish the fabled sect that will become known as the Bene Gesserit.

response.title: Jodorowsky's Dune
response.overview: The tale of Jodorowsky’s doomed film adaptation of the sci-fi novel is a fascinating trip through the pursuit of a dream and the necessity of art.

response.title: The Dune
response.overview: When a woman discovers a mystery man on the beach in southwest France, an aging investigator is called upon to uncover his identity.

response.title: Dune World
response.overview: A crew of minors get stuck on a world that is beyond imagination and learn that they are not alone and about to be targeted by deadly creatures.

response.title: Planet Dune
response.overview: A mission to rescue a marooned base on a desert planet turns deadly when the crew finds themselves hunted and attacked by giant sandworms.

response.title: Dune Drifter
response.overview: When a devastating space battle sends a starfighter crashing into a harsh planet, the sole survivor must save herself before her life support expires.

response.title: Frank Herbert's Children of Dune
response.overview: Dune was just the beginning. Now, Frank Herbert's monumental saga of a young man's rise to super power on an embattled desert planet continues in this extraordinary mini-series based on Dune Messiah and Children of Dune.

response.title: Devil In Dune
response.overview: In a future Earth turned to desert by human impact, survivors seek refuge in the 'Oasis' from mutated 'sand worms'. A diverse team embarks on a perilous journey in an armored vehicle, pursued by these lethal creatures.

response.title: The Sand Dune
response.overview: A seaside restaurant in coastal Texas is where Aylin and Jake met. But after fate tears them apart, can this enchanting eatery them back together?

response.title: The Cremators
response.overview: A giant fireball from outer space grows larger as it consumes humanity, incinerating everything and everyone in its blistering path.

response.title: Dune Warriors
response.overview: In this futuristic tale, a drought-plagued Earth is under attack by outlaws who terrorize small cities to steal any water they might have stored.
